why: 0 verified callers (grep) and the tool fails today (websocket-client missing/undeclared). Repo's own docs already name this exact path as a 0-refs-30d kill candidate. Every read approach -- ours, whatsapp-web.js, Baileys, Selenium, Playwright -- hits the same unofficial web.whatsapp.com surface and carries the same 2026-documented ban risk (~1-in-5 unofficial-API accounts banned/yr); none reduces it. The one ToS-safe option, Cloud API, cannot read pre-existing personal groups at all. This is dead, unwired code, not a library-vs-ours tradeoff.

alternatives.name: whatsapp-web.js
alternatives.covers: Structured Chat/Message API (getChats, fetchMessages) over Puppeteer-driven Chromium; no manual DOM-selector scraping.
alternatives.gap: Own separate QR-paired session (extra credential-at-rest); needs Node+Puppeteer(~300MB Chromium) not used elsewhere in this repo; identical ToS/ban exposure, no less risky.
alternatives.cost: Free/OSS; adds Node+Puppeteer/Chromium toolchain not currently used by any script in this repo.
alternatives.maturity: Widely used historically; current 2026 maintenance cadence not directly confirmed by search.

alternatives.name: Baileys
alternatives.covers: Direct multi-device WS protocol client (no browser); reads groups/messages/media with a lighter runtime than browser automation.
alternatives.gap: 2026 sources show active ban waves incl. 3-year-old bots now suspended (Baileys#1869); stores its own session creds as disk JSON; Node/TS only, no Python path.
alternatives.cost: Free/OSS; Node dependency; no Chromium needed.
alternatives.maturity: Actively developed (WhiskeySockets fork); 2026 search shows escalating, not decreasing, ban enforcement against it.

alternatives.name: Playwright (Python)
alternatives.covers: connect_over_cdp attaches to the SAME already-logged-in Chrome/port our cdp_driver.py hand-rolls, with auto-wait/locators replacing manual sleep()+JS-click dispatch.
alternatives.gap: Still requires hand-writing all WA-specific selector/extraction logic; changes nothing about ToS/ban exposure (same unofficial channel).
alternatives.cost: Free; already pip-installed here (v1.56.0) and already the repo's CDP substrate via MCP; marginal cost ~0.
alternatives.maturity: Actively maintained by Microsoft; high adoption; confirmed installed and Windows-compatible here.

alternatives.name: Selenium
alternatives.covers: Mature WebDriver browser automation; could replace cdp_driver.py's raw JSON-RPC the same way Playwright can.
alternatives.gap: More boilerplate (explicit waits, chromedriver version pinning) than Playwright for the identical job; adopting it would add a 3rd automation convention alongside raw-CDP-here and Playwright-elsewhere.
alternatives.cost: Free/OSS; ongoing chromedriver-version maintenance Playwright already removed elsewhere in this repo.
alternatives.maturity: Extremely mature/stable; industry-standard but older API model than Playwright.

alternatives.name: WhatsApp Cloud API (official)
alternatives.covers: Fully ToS-compliant Meta API; 2026 sources describe near-zero ban risk when using approved templates.
alternatives.gap: Groups feature requires an Official Business Account and covers API-created/managed groups, not a personal account's pre-existing groups -- cannot do the stated job at all.
alternatives.cost: Free tier capped conversations/mo, then paid; needs a dedicated Business-verified number (loses normal personal use).
alternatives.maturity: Official, Meta-maintained, enterprise-grade -- for a different use case than this tool's.
